name: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Qingdao NovelBeam Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sales, and service of medical endoscopic instruments and optical products in China and internationally. The company offers IV endoscopic surgery workstation, camera system, LED cold light source, and laparoscope; OV clinic and surgery workstation; and optics products. It also provides endoscope, light source, camera system, surgical imaging system, endoscopic system, and operation room visualization solutions; optical components, optomechanical modules, and integrated systems; and technical support and value-added services.
